Probate-Morgan

Be it remembered that on the twenty fifth day of January in the year of our Lord One thousand eight Hundred and thirty seven, Letters of Administration on the estate of Samuel Morgan, late of Duck Creek Hundred, deceased were granted to William Morgan of Little Creek Hundred, a brother of said deceased who was sworn and gave bond with Elijah Conselor as his surety in the (unclear) sum of two hundred dollars. Warrant of appraisement issued to James W. Downs and William Clark. In this case Frances Morgan, the widow renounced her right of administration on the estate of her deceasedhusband in favor of the said William Morgan
